previewDigestRoundTrip.notes: Round-trip verified via on-chain previewDigest(0x...beef, [0x...01]) against the redeployed EnrollmentRegistry at 0x92b54725…beE24. Differs from Base Sepolia by chainid (11155111 vs 84532) + registry address.

supersedes.reason: User-direct migration from Base Sepolia (84532) to Ethereum Sepolia (11155111) on 2026-05-29 to consolidate testnet target to canonical Ethereum Sepolia. Old contracts on Base Sepolia remain on-chain but the live demo no longer references them. Sealed demo signature 0xc80557d7c25c9c5b8ae4b770d4eda8690566092bd412d33e372a69526ec42dfb on Base Sepolia is preserved as a historical artifact in the grant proposal.

digestScheme.signature: secp256k1 (r, s, v) over ethSigned, 65 bytes, low-s
matches: viem: walletClient.signMessage({ message: { raw: inner }, account: attester })

notes: Fresh genesis: enrollmentRoot=0x0...0, leafCount=0. OPRF service DB wiped to match at cutover.

Same oprfAttester address (0x876E995c…E246) — the underlying key is reused safely because the digest body includes chainid + address(this), so attester sigs against the old Base Sepolia EnrollmentRegistry cannot replay here.
Block time on Sepolia is ~12s (vs Base Sepolia's ~2s). On-chain step latency in the demo is higher by an order of magnitude.

supersedes_within_sepolia.reason: Initial Sepolia deploy used V2_GENESIS_ROOT=bytes32(0), which mismatched the OPRF service's canonical depth-20 zero-tree root 0x1b49e706…3cd84 → every attester sig recovered to wrong address → BadSignature(). Redeployed with V2_GENESIS_ROOT set to the pedersen-zero-tree root.
